name: HD Hyundai Marine Solution Co
summary: HD Hyundai Marine Solution Co., Ltd. delivers comprehensive, engineering-driven services specifically tailored for Hyundai brand vessels. The company is a key provider of both authentic and bespoke spare parts, complemented by extensive technical assistance, including maintenance, repair, and specialized workshop services. Beyond its maritime focus, the company also caters to stationary engine power plants, offering genuine components, technical assistance, and full operation and maintenance programs. Specializing in ship upgrades, it designs, installs, and commissions retrofit solutions like scrubbers and ballast water treatment systems (BWTS). It further provides advanced digital control and marine automation solutions, along with bunkering and warranty services. Performance optimization services encompass enhancements like ship bow and propeller modifications, slow steaming strategies, and overall vessel optimization. Additionally, it delivers educational programs covering engine performance, operation, maintenance, components, electrical systems, and control mechanisms. Established in 1972, the company maintains its headquarters in Busan, South Korea.
